0022600158.text: The Cavaliers host the Thunder in Cleveland's seventh game of the 2026-27 season, and the Cavaliers come in at 4-2 overall, 3-0 at home, and 4-2 over their last ten with a W1 streak, sitting 2nd in the Central, 1 game back, and 4th in the East. Oklahoma City is also 4-2 but 1-2 on the road, has lost its last two (L2 streak), and sits 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the West. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (day-to-day, hamstring soreness, a game-time decision), while Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Cavaliers lost 0-2 to Oklahoma City in 2025-26, most recently 121-113 in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026.
